name: BMW M3 E46 GTR
description:
The BMW M3 E46 is already a legend in the automotive world, but this Ceky Performance build takes it to an entirely new level. This Gapplebees Special Edition represents a comprehensive transformation of BMW's iconic sports coupe into a track-focused weapon that delivers over 500 horsepower to the rear wheels.

Starting with the E46 M3's legendary inline-6 platform, Ceky Performance has implemented a Stage 1 tuning package that pushes the naturally aspirated engine to 501 bhp at the crank (445 WHP). The result is a visceral driving experience accompanied by an aggressive exhaust note that announces the car's performance credentials. Despite the substantial power increase, the engine maintains the characteristic BMW smoothness and high-revving nature that made the E46 M3 generation so beloved.

This build goes far beyond engine modifications. The exterior features reworked materials for improved durability and aesthetics, while track-focused wheels and suspension provide the grip and handling dynamics needed to exploit the additional power. The interior retains functional features like the animated sunroof (EXTRA D), proving this isn't just a stripped-out track car but a well-rounded performance machine.

Weighing in at just 1,330 kg and pushing the power-to-weight ratio to an impressive 2.65 kg/hp, this Ceky Performance x Gapplebees M3 E46 GTR delivers 0-100 km/h in just 3.4 seconds with a top speed of 300 km/h. It's a proper modern interpretation of what the E46 M3 could be with today's tuning technology.

Original car model by MNBA, extensively modified by Ceky Performance in collaboration with Gapplebees.
author: Ceky Performance
